source: Cleaned notes from the Doom demo of Jev. Concrete numbers are the ones written down. Where a measurement was a real number on screen and was not copied, the value is null and the note says so.

each_weapon.effective_range: the distance at which it is worth using, in the same brackets as everything else

player_physics.note: Both were real values on screen and were not written down.

map_unit.note: The player's size in map units was a real number and was not written down.

distance_brackets.name: medium
distance_brackets.meaning: ranged engagement, and a meaningful travel distance

measurement.vertical_aim: Automatic while the target is in view. If the target is too high above, back off until it is in sight.
measurement.tick_note: The length of one game tick, in seconds, was a real number and was not written down.

control_rate.note: How often a decision is made was a real tick count and a real number of seconds. Neither was written down. Controls persist across decisions.

measurement.projectile_prediction: Closest approach assumes the player stays at the current position. Moving changes it.

velocity.speed_note: Speed was a real number of map units per second and was not written down.

each_enemy_in_view.label: monster name plus a letter id, such as imp B

remembered.label: imp G
remembered.bearing_note: Written as +53 and 'ahead right'. The bearing key says positive is left, so this label disagrees with the sign.

behavior.rule: World knowledge plus the overarching goal and the moment's decisions become a behavior.

from_knowledge.becomes: The kill-enemies goal takes one enemy as its subject. Dodge and movement are then asked about that enemy, as with imp B.
The add-armor goal takes one armor as its subject. Movement walks to it. The answer is that destination, and the behavior is move to position.
The upgrade-weapon goal takes one weapon as its subject. Movement walks to it. The answer is that destination, and the behavior is move to position.
The goal that item serves takes it as the subject. Movement walks to it. The answer is that destination, and the behavior is move to position.
